articles.title: Mystery solved? Why ‘sleeping’ ants suddenly explode with activity
articles.snippet: For decades, scientists have puzzled over what triggers some colonies of ants to burst from rest into community-wide action. Math may now explain this.
articles.summary: Scientists have used math to solve a long-standing mystery about what causes resting ant colonies to suddenly burst into active behavior. This breakthrough explains the triggers behind why sleeping ants wake up with community-wide activity.

articles.title: Analyze This: Microbes can make valuable chemicals more sustainably
articles.snippet: Food waste-fed bacteria may someday make chemical ingredients for medicines, cosmetics and more.
articles.summary: Bacteria fed on food waste might one day be used to create chemical ingredients for medicines and cosmetics. This process could help make valuable chemicals more sustainably.
